message.content: YurikoYamamoto expresses enthusiasm about adding a new dimension to their music using binaural tones. She mentions that it could "add a whole new dimension to our music" and expresses excitement about trying it out. Her statement, "Absolutely! It could add a whole new vibe to our jam sessions!" directly indicates her positive feelings towards incorporating binaural tones into their musical repertoire. Additionally, she suggests testing it out in their next jam session, showing her eagerness to explore this new element.
